name: Unyielding Attack (Combat)
body:
Your desire to destroy your enemies allows you to continue fighting until your Strength fails you.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +10

Benefit: When using Power Attack, if you are dazed, exhausted, fatigued, staggered, or stunned, you postpone the effects of these conditions until you miss an attack roll or cease using Power Attack.

Special: If you suffer the same condition while using Unyielding Power Attack, the duration of effects stack.
